## Working of the Last Program

![Recursive Function Call With Decreasing Value of n](data:image/png;base64,)

An important aspect of recursion is that each recursive call creates a distinct function, even though the function name is the same.

This concept is going to be essential when we learn how to stop infinite recursion.
